title: Line chart component, with the shared chart base
goal: A themed, accessible line chart for values over time
acceptance: bx-line-chart: one or more series over a time or number axis, optional target band and markers (what Grover's plant chart draws), empty state
The shared base (scales, axes, legend, data-table alternative) is written once here and reused by T04 to T06
Unit tests for scales and the data table; browser test: keyboard and axe-clean in every theme, light and dark
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
